summary: Fire towers on Wilton Lookout Tower Hill near Bemidji: a 1925 ladder tower, replaced in 1928. Now gone; the hill is a county day-use area.

facts.design: Two towers on one site: a 1925 ladder tower with octagonal cab, then a 1928 four-legged steel tower with a wood cabin
facts.status_note: Tower removed. Wilton Hill is now a county day-use recreation area with trail access to the old tower site.

access.note: Beltrami County day-use area, open sunrise to sunset; access is not plowed in winter

visit.trail_note: Non-motorized trail access to the old site of a fire tower atop a 1,513 ft hill

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The county report and the A-Z list give 34 feet for the 1925 tower. A 2022 Pioneer photo caption calls the 1934 viewpoint's tower 35 feet. The story uses the report's 34 feet.
The county report dates the first tower to 1925. The Pioneer ties the Larsmount name to the 1928 tower. The story keeps both: 1925 first tower, 1928 replacement.

sources.title: Beltrami County Minnesota Fire Lookout Towers (report)

notes_for_editor: Two towers share the Larsmount site (1925 and 1928); the county report and the A-Z list agree on that. The 1925 and 1928 years and the 34-foot height come from the county report; the Pioneer says the name is for the 1928 tower. No removal date was found, so the event for the 1980 survey notes is dated 1980 and the story does not give a removal year. Staffing sources say only that the tower was used as an observation post in 1930. The record's 'Wilton' name matches the 1930 article and the Pioneer. Not used: a WorthPoint listing of a 1931 Larsmount Lookout postcard, and a 1934 postcard shown only in the Pioneer article. The Pioneer article's date is not shown; its photos are contributed and unlicensed, so no photos were added.
